platform: NVIDIA SM103 (sm_103a, 148 SMs), 4 GPUs, EP4, NVLink
protocol: ABBA palindromic windows inside ONE process (arm vs same-process default_rw0), CUDA Graph replay, 256 MiB L2 flush per replay, slowest rank per window, 15 replays x 5 rounds; "both" mode first runs the randn accuracy gate (bit-exact vs same-process default over every launch + FP32 reference) in the same process. Official DeepGEMM is measured in the same batch.
contamination_rule: Foreign compute processes on the 4 cards are sampled every 2 s; an attempt with any foreign sample is discarded and re-run (max 3). clean=false means all 3 attempts were contaminated: the number is reported but not used for conclusions.

notes.platform: SM103 (148 SMs) x4, EP4, fp8 x fp4 MegaMoE, sm_103a
notes.protocol: ABBA palindromic in-process A/B vs default_rw0, CUDA Graph replay, 256 MiB L2 flush before each replay, slowest rank, 15 replays x 5 rounds, median; official DeepGEMM MegaMoE measured in the same batch with the same protocol; delta = arm - default (negative = faster)
notes.contamination: foreign compute processes on the 4 cards sampled every 2 s; an attempt with any foreign process is discarded and retried (max 3); clean=true iff the kept result comes from a CONTAM=0 attempt; clean=false numbers are reference only
notes.accuracy_gate: randn inputs, 10 consecutive launches, full output tensor bit-exact vs same-process default_rw0 plus finite / rel_l2 vs FP32 reference (rel_l2 ~0.378 Qwen3.8-Max, ~0.321 Qwen3.5-35B, identical for default and arms)
code_changes: U1: 16-warp cooperative head (WEAVE_V_HEAD rounds) kept; measured net negative (see head_off ablations)

U2: TMEM-direct scatter not implemented (2 TMEM accumulator stages; lending one to W00..W03 stalls the MMA); alternative implemented: reg-pull-freed SMEM 16-row slots + 4-slot D7 ring for strict comm_only

U3: gap reduce on W00..W03 implemented (WEAVE_REDUCE_WARPS 1/2 with comm_only), measured strongly negative; 16-warp tail kept and fixed: SM0 cleanup-barrier wait deferred to the end of the all-16 tail, runtime 1 KiB sub-chunks when 2 KiB sub-chunks give fewer tiles per SM than reduce warps

U4: ADAPT_BM ladder places 32-row tiles only as an expert's single tile (odd SF TMEM column faulted on SM103); host rejects fixed 32-row sub-tiles inside larger envelopes; host SMEM planner accum-stage default aligned with codegen (16 B under-allocation at BM=256); ADAPT auto envelope capped at 128 rows (BM=256 spills on sm_103a)

U5: sm_103a ptxas: default, rg4, strict comm_only, strict+reg-pull, strict+reg-pull+profiler, ADAPT_BM variants all 128 regs / 0 spill; a BM=256 envelope spills (428 B on the previous commit, 444 B now) and is no longer produced by ADAPT
known_failures: Head (U1) is net negative on every measured shape: head-off ablation -22.6 us (S=1024), -32.8 us clean (S=4096), -99.4 us clean (skew S=4096), -2 to -4 us (Qwen3.5)
Gap reduce (U3, WEAVE_REDUCE_WARPS=1/2 + comm_only): +710 to +2972 us; root cause: per-slot fence.acq_rel.sys plus publish wait on all slots

ADAPT_BM is correct after the fix (S=1024/4096/8192, uniform and skew, randn, 10 launches, bit-exact) but slower at S=4096 (+321.6 us clean), skew S=4096 (+174.3 us clean) and S=8192 (+718.9 us clean; the same-batch official was contaminated, 1039-1044 us, reference only)
WEAVE_DISPATCH_WARPS=8 / WEAVE_SCATTER_WARPS=8 hang on Qwen3.5-35B S=8192; not measured

final_capture.config: Qwen3.8-Max S=1024 (S_rank=256), WEAVE_REG_PULL_BYTES=2048 (strongest legal arm that still runs the 16-warp head; ADAPT_BM is faster but compiles the head out)
final_capture.tool: nsys gb11x GPU metrics 200 kHz + in-kernel software recorder, same run, taskset 0-15, nice -10, no banner

notes.adapt_bm_s8192: JIT at S_rank=2048 now builds a 128-row envelope with 7 GEMM stages, 128 regs, 0 local memory (no spill); before the fix it built BM=256 and failed the host-SMEM static_assert
